title: Development Task List
lede: Systematic breakdown of engineering deliverables, algorithmic components, and implementation progress across all simulation subsystems.

tasks.title: 25x25 Grid Matrix World Model
tasks.description: Construct discrete 2D Tile matrix with coordinate indexing and Moore neighborhood boundary checks.

tasks.title: Terrain Biome Generator
tasks.description: Implement procedural terrain generator matching distribution ratios: Plains 60%, Forest 25%, Water 10%, Mountains 5%.

tasks.title: Neighbor-Aware Spawning System
tasks.description: Distribute animals and resource clusters with non-adjacent spawn spacing.

tasks.title: Metabolic Status Decay Dynamics
tasks.description: Establish turn-by-turn hunger (-5) and thirst (-8) decay with starvation and dehydration damage triggers.

tasks.title: Species Archetypes & Passive Traits
tasks.description: Define Herbivore, Carnivore, and Omnivore species classes with Ambush Predator and Efficient Grazer passives.

tasks.title: Combat Resolution Engine
tasks.description: Implement STR-based damage calculation and AGI-based evasion check algorithms.

tasks.title: Weekly Natural Disaster Scheduler
tasks.description: Trigger scheduled environmental disasters (Wildfire, Blizzard, Flash Flood) on 7-turn intervals.

tasks.title: Stochastic Event Checks (d10 System)
tasks.description: Build d10 dice roll check engine for Rockslides and Contamination saves.

tasks.title: 41-16-12-8 MLP Neural Network
tasks.description: Implement feedforward forward pass with dual ReLU hidden layers and sensory grid flattening.

tasks.title: Composite Fitness Evaluator
tasks.description: Calculate multivariable fitness score based on survival time, gathered forage, kills, distance, and disasters survived.

tasks.title: Genetic Operator Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement Elitism (top 10%), tournament selection, single-point crossover, and Gaussian weight mutation.

tasks.title: Pygame Interactive Simulation Viewer
tasks.description: Render 25x25 spatial grid with live sprite icons, health bars, and event notifications.

tasks.title: Generational Analytics Exporter
tasks.description: Export CSV/JSON generational survival metrics, trait divergence charts, and fitness trends.
